Officer's narrative
At an intersection in Baytown, Texas, Driver 1 and Driver 2 were involved in a side-impact collision. Driver 1 was
traveling through the intersection when Driver 2's vehicle entered from the cross street and struck the driver's side of
Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 2 confirmed at the scene that the collision happened as Driver 1 described it. Two
independent witnesses gave statements consistent with both drivers, and photographs taken at the scene show
damage concentrated on the driver's side, which is consistent with the reported impact. Passenger was seated in the
front passenger seat, and both the responding officer and the witnesses confirmed that Passenger was present in the
vehicle at the time. Driver 1 reported lower back pain and stiffness shortly after the collision. The injury appears
consistent with the type and force of the impact. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was observed or reported.
Driver 1 was shown as the named insured on the policy documents provided at the scene. No citations were issued at
the time of the report.
